description: This file defines the SumSquares class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for various sum of squares calculations used in spreadsheet functions such as SUMSQ and related operations.

classes.name: SumSquares
classes.description: A class providing static methods to perform various sum of squares calculations used in spreadsheet formulas.

methods.name: sumSquare
methods.description: Calculates the sum of the squares of given arguments, implementing the Excel SUMSQ functionality.

methods.name: sumXSquaredMinusYSquared
methods.description: Computes the sum of the squares of elements in matrixData1 minus the squares of elements in matrixData2.

methods.name: sumXSquaredPlusYSquared
methods.description: Computes the sum of the squares of elements in matrixData1 plus the squares of elements in matrixData2.

methods.name: sumXMinusYSquared
methods.description: Calculates the sum of squared differences between corresponding elements of matrixData1 and matrixData2.
